<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13112024-10-2113-14-43" status="unreviewed">[⁽1763⁾]<rs type="person" ana="">tsha na re</rs> spyir de ma thag rkyen du 'gyur ba la shes pa gzhan gyis chod na skyon du 'gyur gyi dus gzhan gyis chod pas mi skyon de 'gog pa la zhugs pa bzhin no|[ ]|des na mnyam par 'jog kha ma'i shes pa nyid la skye'o|[ ]|<rs type="school">phar phyin pa</rs> kun la yang mnyam bzhag snang ba yod med gnyis la med pa'i lugs kyang 'di dang mthun pa 'dra zhes gsungs|_<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre </rs>ni khong <?oxy_comment_start comment="[bold face in source document]"?>thal ba<?oxy_comment_end?> yang min te mnyam bzhag na shesapa dngos po la yod cing mnyam bzhag gi blo ngo na med pas spros par mi 'gyur gsung ste babs che che 'dra|_so sa bon las skye'i mngon gyur med pas zer|
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">khyung na re</rs> mnyam bzhag don dam yin zhing <?oxy_comment_start comment="[bold face in source document]"?>thal bas<?oxy_comment_end?> mnyam bzhag na sems rgyun chad dgos la|_rjes shes ni kun rdzob tu rang gi rigs snga ma las skye ste bum pa'i bden gnyis bzhin zer te <?oxy_comment_start comment="[bold face in source document]"?>go rgyu tsam mi 'dug<?oxy_comment_end?>_rang gi rtog pa la mnyam bzhag na mi rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyun ma bcad par bde|_de rnal 'byor mngon sum yin min ni chos nyid la ltos nas mngon sum dang shes pa gnyis char btags pa ba ste|_gzung ba dang shes bya nyid med pas so|[ ]|shes pa nyid pa ste mi rtog par gnas so|[ ]|_|mnyam bzhag gis ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa bshad zin to||___||</seg></TEI>
